title: Validate Pull Request Diff Gate
description: Draft command semantic instance for validating a pull-request diff against the current main branch.
purpose: Validate changed paths for forbidden implementation/runtime directories, source-path mirroring, unauthorized implementation extraction, forbidden naming, and other pull-request scoped guard rules before merge.
outputs: pull-request validator findings on standard output
failureSemantics: Non-zero exit indicates forbidden or unauthorized changed paths, source-path mirroring, implementation directory creation, unresolved source-disposition context, or a git diff failure. The command is advisory validation and must fail closed on ambiguous implementation extraction risk.
aiGuidance: Run this command before merging PRs. Passing PR output does not start USF-39, authorize runtime code, or override semantic authority.
